title.official: Limitation on when judgment or noting in default may occur

variants.BOOK_A: Limitation onWhen Judgment or Noting in Default May Occur

division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.42   Despite anything in this Division, judgment may not be
entered against a defendant and a defendant may not be noted in
default if the defendant has filed an application that has not been
decided
(a) to set aside service of a statement of claim, or
(b) under rule 3.68 to set aside or amend a statement of claim,
to strike out a claim, or to stay an action, application or
proceeding.
